S.FORM: aimi kebalan azu ngid kataz qatiw sa lazing nani.
S.PHON: aimi kəβaran a[z|r]u ŋiɮ kata[z|r] qatiw sa ra[z|r]iŋ nani
S.FORM: aimi kebalan azu ngid kataz qatiw sa lazing nani.
S.PHON: aimi kəβaran a[z|r]u ŋiɮ kata[z|r] qatiw sa ra[z|r]iŋ nani
S.TRANSL: 如果我們噶瑪蘭人想去海邊,
If we Kavalan people want to go to the sea,

FORM.notes: source note: k<en>ilim ni buya | source note: k<en>ilim(-an)-ku | source note: qena-kilim-an-ku | source note: sa-kilim-an-ku

S.TRANSL: (我們)絕對會找伴(一起去).
(we) will definitely ask friends (to come with us).

FORM.notes: source note: qasulun=pa=ita matiw q<m>an | source note: masulun=ita kwa masang matiw q<m>an

S.TRANSL: 一起去海邊比較好
It's better if we go to the sea together.
更能高高興興在那裡.
Being much happier there.
如果到了海邊,
If (we) arrive at the sea,

FORM.notes: source note: pa-Ri-baut-an=iku | source note: Ri-baut不能改成qi-baut。 | source note: qi-waRang | source note: p<m>azing的z比較像c。

S.TRANSL: 男人下水抓魚和射魚.
Men dive into the waters, catching and spearing fish.
女人撿笠螺和螺類.
Women pick up limpets and shells.

S.FORM: u yaupama nayi qiqakutung u iza ya.
S.PHON: u jaupama naji qiqakutuŋ u i[z|r]a ja
S.FORM: u yaupama nayi qiqakutung u iza ya.
S.PHON: u jaupama naji qiqakutuŋ u i[z|r]a ja
S.TRANSL: 或撿海菜.
or pick up seaweed.

FORM.notes: source note: *ngid qan sa-tutu-an | source note: mai ngid qan sa-tutu

S.FORM: nisianguzusanna ngid qan satutu nizanta pazukat.
S.PHON: nisiaŋu[z|r]usanna ŋiɮ qan satutu ni[z|r]anta pa[z|r]ukat
S.FORM: nisianguzusanna ngid qan satutu nizanta pazukat.
S.PHON: nisiaŋu[z|r]usanna ŋiɮ qan satutu ni[z|r]anta pa[z|r]ukat
S.TRANSL: 中午要吃飯的時候,在海邊所採的東西全部都拿出來.
We take out all that we have picked up at sea when it is time for lunch.

W.TRANSL: 完成-在海邊撿食物-名物化-3PL.屬格

FORM.notes: source note: sa-tutu-an | source note: sa-tutu-an-ta ngid tazian | source note: sa-saRi-an | source note: ni-Ramaz-an=ay baut | source note: mai=pama ma-Ramaz=ay baut

S.FORM: sa satutuan yau metiay yau maninay.
S.PHON: sa satutuan jau mətiaj jau maninaj
S.FORM: sa satutuan yau metiay yau maninay.
S.PHON: sa satutuan jau mətiaj jau maninaj
S.TRANSL: 中午吃的有生的有熟的.
There are raw and cooked food for lunch.

FORM.notes: source note: 老師覺得沒有ni-ta-lepaw-an,應改為nizi ta-lepaw-an | source note: Informant thinks that there is no ‘ni-ta-repaw-an’, which should be changed to nizi ta-lepaw-an.

S.FORM: satutuan maiita mazas tu ninuay nitalepawan matiw sa lazing.
S.PHON: satutuan maiita ma[z|r]as tu ninuaj nitarəpawan matiw sa ra[z|r]iŋ
S.FORM: satutuan maiita mazas tu ninuay nitalepawan matiw sa lazing.
S.PHON: satutuan maiita ma[z|r]as tu ninuaj nitarəpawan matiw sa ra[z|r]iŋ
S.TRANSL: 我們不帶家裡的東西去海邊.
We don't take food from home to the sea.

FORM.notes: source note: zana ninu | source note: zana lazing=ay | source note: qawman mawtu | source note: qawman mawtu=ti ti-imuy | source note: qawman qawtu ti-imuy | source note: q<en>atiw-an | source note: q<en>awtu-ku

S.FORM: qawman wama zana lazingay tamunniq tayan.
qawman wama zana lazingay tamunniq tayan.
S.TRANSL: 我們的菜絕對只有海邊的菜.
Our foods are definitely only those picked up at the sea.

FORM.notes: source note: sa-azas-an | source note: ninu ni-azas-an-su | source note: mana m-azas=isu

S.TRANSL: 帶的東西只有飯和鹽.
What are brought (from home) are only rice and salt.

FORM.notes: source note: mana nayau | source note: mana=ti aizipna

S.FORM: nayau zana kebalan matiw sa lazing.
nayau zana kebalan matiw sa lazing.
S.TRANSL: 噶瑪蘭人是那樣子去海邊的.
That is how Kavalan people go to the sea.

FORM.notes: source note: 這裡的sa-qa-lizaq-an不能改成pa-qa-lizaq-an #n satzay=pa=iku pa-qa-lizaq tu sunis | source note: ni-qa-nengi-an | source note: sa-qa-lizaq-an here cannot be changed to pa-qa-lizaq-an.

S.TRANSL: 使我們高興及好的生活方式.
the way of life which makes us happy and good
我們是這樣想的.
That's how we think.
